hypotheses.note: Causal.Flat.FlatQuotient.not_isCausal_timeGroup (Causal/Flat/Quotient.lean:741), stated at the same causality by abbrev unfolding

findings: Stronger than not causal: the cylinder is totally vicious, x ≪_M y for ALL x, y (Causal.Flat.timeCylinder_lt_top). For x = [a], y = [b], choose n : ℤ with ‖b₂ − a₂‖ < n + b₁ − a₁; then a ≪ n e₀ + b in 𝐌ⁿ (minkowski_lt_top_iff), and the projection, a strong morphism (FlatQuotient.strongMorphism_proj), carries this to [a] ≪_M [n e₀ + b] = [b]. The failures of strong causality (open and closed forms), of a time function and of global hyperbolicity follow from ¬ IsCausal through the existing edges (StronglyCausal.isCausal with T1, StronglyCausalOpen.stronglyCausal, HasTimeFunction.isCausal, GloballyHyperbolic.isCausal) and are stated for convenience.

labels.label: T-loc-flat-time-cylinder/4-not-causally-compact

hypotheses.note: (hd : 1 ≤ d) on timeCylinder_not_compactSpace, timeCylinder_not_causallyCompact, timeCylinder_separates only; Minkowski d has d space dimensions (kb/0024). Necessary: timeCylinder_causallyCompact_iff (CausallyCompact ↔ d = 0)

findings: The evidence's argument (programme/roadmap.toml:1047, 'a lift of any q lies in the future cone of a lift of p, so J(p, q) is the whole cylinder, not compact when d ≥ 1') is correct as stated and proved: every diamond J_M(p, q) is the whole cylinder (timeCylinder_diamond, from timeCylinder_le_top), so causal compactness is compactness of the cylinder (timeCylinder_causallyCompact_iff_compactSpace). For 1 ≤ d the spatial norm ‖a₂‖, invariant under ℤ e₀, descends by Quotient.lift to a continuous function (TimeCylinder.spaceNorm), unbounded (the class of (0, single 0 (|R| + 1))), so the cylinder is not compact.

The hypothesis d ≥ 1 cannot be dropped: for d = 0 (Minkowski 0 = the timelike line ℝ) the cylinder is the timelike circle ℝ/ℤ, the image of the slab [0, 1] × 𝐑⁰, compact (TimeCylinder.instCompactSpaceZero), hence causally compact (timeCylinder_causallyCompact_iff: CausallyCompact ↔ d = 0).

kb_entry_proposed.title: The flat time cylinder: an absolutely minimal ETT spacetime with every local ladder property and ≪ total
kb_entry_proposed.body: `Causal.Flat.TimeCylinder d = FlatQuotient (timeGroup d) ⊤`, causality `timeCylinder d = flatCausality d _` (`Causal.Model.FlatTimeCylinder`): T2, second countable (instance), connected (instance); curves extend, absolutely minimal, causally arc-connected, push-up, tarentin, chronal neighbours, causally open, causally plain, every `d`; `x ≪_M y` for all `x, y` (`timeCylinder_lt_top`), so every diamond is the whole space and causal compactness is compactness: false for `d ≥ 1` (`timeCylinder_separates`), true for `d = 0`, the timelike circle (`timeCylinder_zero_separates`, a witness of causally_compact ⇏ is_causal). Use it before building a witness for a separation into is_causal, strongly_causal, time_function or causally_compact: it holds in either reading of defi:causalite. Reading a relation of a quotient `FlatQuotient Γ ⊤`: lift to `𝐌ⁿ`, use `isIsometricEmbedding_subtype_val.rel_iff` and `flatCausality_self` (the `⊤`-subtype is `minkowski d`; Quotient.lean's `le_top_subtype_iff` is private), push down by `strongMorphism_proj.le_of_mapsTo`/`lt_of_mapsTo`; a Γ-invariant function descends by `Quotient.lift` with `Continuous.quotient_lift` (T-loc-flat-time-cylinder).

kb_proposals: The flat time cylinder (Causal.Flat.TimeCylinder d, timeCylinder d) is the cheap absolutely minimal ETT spacetime with every local ladder property (curves_extend, absolutely_minimal, causally_arc_connected, push_up, tarentin, chronal_neighbours, causally_open, causally_plain) and ≪_M total; not causally compact for d ≥ 1, causally compact for d = 0 (the timelike circle). Separations into is_causal and its consequences hold in either reading (T-loc-flat-time-cylinder).

Graduation: move to Causal/Model/FlatTimeCylinder.lean, module Causal.Model.FlatTimeCylinder; the declarations stay in namespace Causal.Flat (Causal.Flat.TimeCylinder, Causal.Flat.timeCylinder, Causal.Flat.timeCylinder_*), as the flat library's are; if the master prefers namespace Causal for Model modules, every witness name above changes accordingly. Three global instances are declared on the abbrev TimeCylinder (ConnectedSpace, SecondCountableTopology for every d; CompactSpace for d = 0), all Prop-valued. Beyond the dispatch: causal plainness (optional, done), the totality of ≪ (timeCylinder_lt_top), the d = 0 circle and the iff CausallyCompact ↔ d = 0 (sharpness of d ≥ 1), and the four derived failures (strong causality in both forms, time function, global hyperbolicity). The circle entry overlaps T-abs-doubled-line-compact's first item for the ladder (causally_compact ⇏ is_causal) with an absolutely minimal witness; whether that makes the doubled line's entry redundant is the planner's and keeper's to judge, not mine. Evidence, not a ruling.
